kpis.description_fr: CA Beer (Modelo Especial, Corona, Pacifico). Modelo #1 bière US en volume depuis 2023. Croissance dépend mix consommateur hispanique + tariffs.
kpis.description_en: Beer net sales (Modelo Especial, Corona, Pacifico). Modelo #1 US beer by volume since 2023. Growth tied to Hispanic consumer mix + tariffs.

kpis.description_fr: Croissance volumes Beer (depletions). Ralentissement marqué 2025 (tariffs Mexique, soft Hispanic consumer). Historique solide.
kpis.description_en: Beer depletion growth. Marked slowdown 2025 (Mexico tariffs, soft Hispanic consumer). Solid history.

kpis.description_fr: Marge op Beer. Très élevée, structurellement >35%. Pression coûts (glass, aluminum, tariffs) compensée partiellement pricing.
kpis.description_en: Beer op margin. Very high, structurally >35%. Cost pressure (glass, aluminum, tariffs) partly offset by pricing.

kpis.description_fr: CA Wine & Spirits post-cessions mainstream. Focus premium (Kim Crawford, Meiomi, Casa Noble). Désinvestissement progressif.
kpis.description_en: Wine & Spirits sales post mainstream divestitures. Premium focus (Kim Crawford, Meiomi, Casa Noble). Gradual divestment.

kpis.description_fr: Capacité production bière Mexique (Nava, Obregon, Veracruz). Expansion progressive 7 Mds $ sur cycle, en pause 2025 (demande molle).
kpis.description_en: Mexico beer brewing capacity (Nava, Obregon, Veracruz). $7B expansion cycle, paused 2025 (soft demand).
